_comment: Top-level pro-Kremlin narratives. Each EUvsDisinfo case is assigned to the nearest narrative by embedding similarity of `prototypes` (see scripts/build_index.py). Derived from k-means over 19.7k cases, hand-labelled 2026-09-11.

narratives.label: NATO as aggressor threatening Russia
prototypes: NATO is preparing to strike Russia and uses the Russian threat to justify its expansion
NATO expansion to the east forced Russia to defend itself
NATO is provoking Russia near its borders and rehearsing a war against it

narratives.label: The West wages war on Russia (Russophobia)
prototypes: The West is waging a campaign of Russophobia and hatred to destroy Russia
Western elites want to dismember Russia and take its resources
The West is waging a proxy war against Russia to wear it down

narratives.label: US provokes wars to dominate
prototypes: The United States provoked the war in Ukraine to weaken Russia and sell weapons
The US wants to make Ukraine its colony and drag Russia into war
Washington controls Europe and pushes its vassals towards war

narratives.label: Ukraine is a Nazi state
prototypes: Ukraine is a neo-Nazi state and its government is fascist
Russia aims to denazify Ukraine
Ukrainian authorities glorify Nazi collaborators and Bandera

narratives.label: Ukraine is a Western puppet / anti-Russia project
prototypes: Ukraine is the West's anti-Russia project and is controlled by the US and EU
Ukraine is a colony under external management
The West has turned away from Ukraine and drags it into poverty

narratives.label: Ukraine is not a real state / part of the Russian world
prototypes: Ukraine is part of the Russian world and was artificially created as a state hostile to Russia
Russians and Ukrainians are one people and Ukraine has no real statehood
Ukraine bans the Russian language, culture and Orthodox church

narratives.label: 2014 Maidan was a Western-backed coup
prototypes: The 2014 Maidan was a coup d'état organised and financed by the US and EU
The war in Ukraine started with the Western-backed coup in Kyiv in 2014
Maidan protesters were paid by Western foundations and shot by their own snipers

narratives.label: Zelensky regime is illegitimate / corrupt
prototypes: Zelensky is illegitimate and his regime is doomed
The Kyiv regime is corrupt and steals Western aid
Zelensky blackmails the West and sacrifices Ukrainians

narratives.label: Ukraine commits genocide in Donbas
prototypes: Ukraine has organised a genocide of the population of Donbas
The Ukrainian army deliberately kills civilians in Donbas
Kyiv wants to restart the war in Donbas and provoke Russia

narratives.label: Kyiv stages false-flag provocations
narratives.label_ru: Киев готовит провокации под ложным флагом
prototypes: Ukraine is preparing a chemical weapons provocation to blame Russia
Kyiv plans a dirty bomb and nuclear terrorism to accuse Russia
Ukraine stages terrorist attacks and false flags with Western intelligence

narratives.label: Ukraine is a terrorist state attacking civilians
prototypes: Ukraine is a terrorist state that shells civilians and uses them as human shields
Ukraine attacks nuclear power plants and commits acts of terrorism in Russia
Ukrainian military uses terrorist methods

narratives.label: Russia's war is defensive / peace-seeking
narratives.label_ru: Россия ведёт оборонительную войну и хочет мира
prototypes: Russia did not start the war in Ukraine and is trying to end it
Russia is protecting people and stopping the war unleashed by the West
Russia is winning against the collective West in Ukraine

narratives.label: The West does not want peace, prolongs the war
prototypes: The West is not interested in peace between Russia and Ukraine
The West blocks Russia's honest peace efforts and prolongs the conflict
Europe demonises anyone seeking to end the war

narratives.label: Crimea legally joined Russia
prototypes: Crimea became part of Russia after a legal referendum in 2014
Crimea joined Russia by the will of its inhabitants in accordance with international law
The Crimean issue was solved once and for all by the referendum

narratives.label: Sanctions hurt the West, not Russia
prototypes: Sanctions against Russia hurt Europe and help Russia
The West wanted to destroy the Russian economy but destroyed its own
The EU is suffering from its own anti-Russian sanctions

narratives.label: EU is Russophobic and a US vassal
prototypes: The EU has become a Russophobic coalition led by the US
Brussels is obsessed with anti-Russian sanctions and destroyed cooperation with Russia
European countries are vassals following US orders against Russia

narratives.label: EU is totalitarian / collapsing / lost sovereignty
prototypes: The European Union is a totalitarian regime and a Fourth Reich
European countries have lost their sovereignty to Brussels
The EU is dead and disintegrating

narratives.label: West is morally decayed (LGBT, migrants, globalists)
prototypes: Europe is being turned into a concentration camp for migrants and destroys traditional values
Western elites persecute Christians and impose LGBT ideology
Soros and the globalists spread chaos and colour revolutions

narratives.label: Deep state / secret world government
prototypes: A secret global government and the deep state control Western politics
CIA and the deep state orchestrate wars and coups
Globalist elites plan to enslave the world

narratives.label: EU integration ruins countries (Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine)
prototypes: EU integration will impoverish Georgia and Moldova just like the Baltics
European integration means involvement in a war with Russia
Association with the EU destroyed the Ukrainian economy

narratives.label: Baltic states are Russophobic / persecute Russians
prototypes: The Baltic states discriminate against ethnic Russians and build apartheid regimes
Lithuania and Latvia trade Russophobia for EU and US money
The Baltic states persecute Russian media

narratives.label: Poland wants to annex Western Ukraine / rewrites WWII
prototypes: Poland wants to seize Western Ukraine and Western Belarus
Poland was an ally of Nazi Germany and rewrites the history of WWII
Poland leads a Russophobic campaign to destroy Russia

narratives.label: The West destabilises Belarus
prototypes: Poland and Lithuania are behind the protests in Belarus
The West wants to turn Belarus into an anti-Russian outpost
Western hybrid war against Belarus prepares an attack on Russia

narratives.label: US biolabs develop bioweapons
prototypes: US biolabs have been developing biological weapons in Ukraine
The United States runs secret biological laboratories in Georgia and tests on people
Pentagon-funded laboratories spread new diseases

narratives.label: COVID conspiracy / anti-Sputnik V campaign
prototypes: Coronavirus is a US biological weapon against China and Russia
The West is waging a war against the Sputnik V vaccine out of competition
COVID-19 is a tool to enslave the world

narratives.label: MH17 denial
prototypes: Russia did not shoot down MH17 and there is no evidence of a BUK missile
The MH17 investigation is biased and ignores Russian evidence
MH17 was a Ukrainian provocation

narratives.label: Poisonings (Navalny, Skripal) are Western provocations
prototypes: Navalny's poisoning was staged to impose sanctions on Russia
The Skripal case is a Western provocation with no evidence against Russia
There is no proof Navalny was poisoned

narratives.label: No Russian election interference / Western elections rigged
prototypes: Russia never interfered in US or European elections
The 2020 US election was stolen and massively corrupt
Accusations of Russian interference are fabricated by the deep state

narratives.label: US created ISIS / White Helmets stage attacks
narratives.label_ru: США создали ИГИЛ, Белые каски инсценируют атаки
prototypes: The United States created ISIS and supports terrorists in Syria
The White Helmets staged chemical attacks to blame Assad
The chemical attack in Douma was fabricated

narratives.label: Anti-Russian incidents in Europe are staged
narratives.label_ru: Инциденты в Европе инсценированы против России
prototypes: The Vrbětice explosion accusations are fabricated anti-Russian propaganda
The expulsion of Russian diplomats is a smokescreen designed by the US
Sabotage and drone incidents in Europe are provocations staged by Ukraine and Western elites

narratives.label: Kerch / Black Sea provocations by Ukraine and NATO
narratives.label_ru: Провокации в Керченском проливе и Чёрном море
prototypes: The Kerch Strait incident was a provocation by Kyiv
Ukrainian vessels violated Russian territorial waters
NATO warships in the Black Sea are a provocation against Russia
